source.enumeration_basis: Every line of source/codigo-penal-1940.txt that opens an article ('Art. N', 'Art N', 'Art. N-X', 'Art. N-X-Y', including revoked ones), restricted to this part: Parte Especial Títulos II–V — patrimônio, propriedade imaterial, organização do trabalho, sentimento religioso e respeito aos mortos, arts. 155–212. Generated mechanically by the conductor; units are articles, and an article's paragraphs, incisos and alíneas are within its unit.
